title: RIP
premise: Opus declares finance, accounting and video editing dead. Her fourth boast is about programmers. She needs Alex to close one parenthesis.

scenes.label: Cash flow forecast
scenes.description: The cash forecast completes. A short boom lands with the Finance tombstone.

scenes.label: Bank reconciliation
scenes.description: Invoice amounts match their bank entries. The second boom lands on the Accounting tombstone.

scenes.label: Video timeline
scenes.description: The silence is cut and the clips snap together. The Video editing stone lands on the same beat.

scenes.label: The blog post
scenes.description: Opus turns the laptop and shows the single post behind the three claims.

scenes.anchor: Okay. That one was kind of cool.
scenes.label: The rough cut
scenes.description: She sees herself in the rough cut and smiles.

scenes.label: One word
scenes.description: She replaces help with replace and tries the same boast about programmers.

scenes.label: Build failed
scenes.description: Publish produces a red error and an unclosed call.

scenes.label: A favor
scenes.description: She angles the laptop toward Alex.

scenes.label: One parenthesis
scenes.description: Alex leans in, closes the call, hits Enter and leaves.

scenes.label: The green banner
scenes.description: One second of silence, a deadpan admission, and a hard cut.
